about_the_game:
High stakes rocket-powered precision sheep platformer. As a sheep strapped to a rocket, boost up and climb through perilous terrain and traps to reach the goal before everyone else. Every sheep has dreamed of touching the stars, will you be the first?

Tackle the single player story and challenges, or take your precision skills (and pure rage) into the multiplayer area. Be the sheep that flies the furthest the faster.

(Enjoy the demo alongside development. Actively looking for feedback on gameplay and multiplayer while we continue polishing visuals, and levels)

Features

  • Rage / Precision platformer with escalating challenges
  • Multiple difficulty modes to suit beginners and pros alike
  • Multiplayer lobbies with friends or take your chances with open lobbies
  • Highly customizable multiplayer gameplay for everyone
  • Customizable cosmetics and unlockables
  • Simple to learn, difficult to master

(This game is under active development, join the Discord Server or the Email List to help shape the future of the title.
